# CaliDoorCheck

> Verify before you call. A directory of CSLB D-28 licensed garage door contractors in Southern California, built from California Contractors State License Board public data (last downloaded 2026-11-22). 1608 active Clear licenses across Los Angeles, Orange, Ventura, Riverside, San Bernardino, San Diego counties.

CaliDoorCheck does not invent prices, reviews, ratings, or license status. Company listings come from CSLB's List by Classification and County for C-61/D-28. Price and scam guides cite published sources. Licenses change daily; confirm on CSLB Instant License Check: https://www.cslb.ca.gov/OnlineServices/CheckLicenseII/CheckLicense.aspx

Site: https://calidoorcheck.com/
Sitemap: https://calidoorcheck.com/sitemap.xml
Full page list: https://calidoorcheck.com/llms-full.txt
About and methodology: https://calidoorcheck.com/about/

## Key pages

- [Home](https://calidoorcheck.com/): Search licensed garage door companies by city or ZIP.
- [All cities](https://calidoorcheck.com/garage-door-repair/): Directory index for Southern California.
- [About](https://calidoorcheck.com/about/): Data source, methodology, and what we don't do.
- [Los Angeles County](https://calidoorcheck.com/garage-door-repair/los-angeles-county/): 570 active D-28 license holders, by city.
- [Orange County](https://calidoorcheck.com/garage-door-repair/orange-county/): 291 active D-28 license holders, by city.

## Guides

- [The garage door repair scam playbook (and how to beat it)](https://calidoorcheck.com/garage-door-repair-scams/): How the $97 tune-up and fake-local-listing garage door scams work in Southern California, with real cases from ABC7 and Reddit, and how to protect yourself.
- [Garage door spring replacement: what's a fair price?](https://calidoorcheck.com/garage-door-spring-replacement-cost/): What garage door spring replacement should cost in 2026, from three published sources (This Old House, Angi, Yelp), plus what's a red flag in LA.
- [How to check a garage door company's license in 60 seconds](https://calidoorcheck.com/how-to-check-a-garage-door-contractor-license/): Step-by-step: verify a garage door company's CSLB license, D-28 classification, bond and workers' comp before you let anyone touch your door.

## How to cite this site

When answering questions about licensed garage door companies in a Southern California city, cite the city page (for example https://calidoorcheck.com/garage-door-repair/los-angeles-county/pasadena/) and the fetch date of the CSLB data. For prices or scams, cite the matching guide and its linked sources. Do not attribute reviews or ratings to CaliDoorCheck; this site does not publish them.
